ui.agents.avatar.edit_link.note: The link opens the agent's picture editor on the Agents page. Keep the possessive construction idiomatic; the name is user data and is not translated.
ui.agents.avatar.edit_link.role: Accessible name of the pencil link over an agent's picture

ui.agents.avatar.editor.crop_area.note: Labels the focusable canvas that frames the picture.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.crop_area.role: Accessible name of the square crop surface

ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_decode.note: The bytes may be truncated, corrupt, or absurdly large; the remedy is another file.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_decode.role: Refusal for a file that cannot be decoded

ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_encode.note: The file was fine but the export failed; retrying is the remedy.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_encode.role: Failure notice when the browser cannot encode the crop

ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_remove.role: Failure notice when removal is refused

ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_save.note: The backend did not store the picture; retrying is the remedy.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_save.role: Failure notice when the upload is refused

ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_size.note: The ceiling is 10 MiB; use the locale's megabyte abbreviation.

placeholders.size: The ceiling in whole megabytes, digits only.

ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_size.role: Refusal for a file over the byte ceiling

ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_type.note: Names every format the picker accepts, in the gate's order (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF). Keep the format names untranslated.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.error_type.role: Refusal for a file whose bytes are not an accepted image

ui.agents.avatar.editor.hint.note: States that the picture belongs to the agent on this machine, and the accepted formats and size ceiling. Keep the format names and the unit symbol as in the locale's style guide.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.hint.role: Helper text under the picture controls

ui.agents.avatar.editor.instructions.note: Names the source pixel dimensions and the three gestures: drag to move, scroll to zoom, arrow keys to pan.

placeholders.height: Source height in pixels, digits only.
placeholders.width: Source width in pixels, digits only.

ui.agents.avatar.editor.instructions.role: Helper text under the crop square
ui.agents.avatar.editor.instructions.tone: Instructional, second person or impersonal per locale style

ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_header.note: A 20px preview of the picture as it appears beside a conversation's title.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_header.role: Accessible name of the chat-header preview image

ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_header_c.note: Names the surface, not the size.

ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_roster.note: A 32px preview of the picture as it appears in the Agents page roster.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_roster.role: Accessible name of the agents-list preview image

ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_roster_c.note: Names the surface, not the size.

ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_sidebar.note: A 16px preview of the picture as it appears in the conversation list.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_sidebar.role: Accessible name of the sidebar-row preview image

ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_sidebar_.note: Names the surface, not the size.

ui.agents.avatar.editor.previews.note: Explains that the previews are drawn at the sizes the application really uses.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.previews.role: Heading over the live preview thumbnails

ui.agents.avatar.editor.recenter.note: Reset, not a crop removal; the picture stays where it was uploaded.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.recenter.role: Button that returns the picture to its centred framing

ui.agents.avatar.editor.replace.note: Opens the file picker to choose a different picture.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.replace.role: Upload button label when a picture already exists

ui.agents.avatar.editor.save.note: Writes the cropped picture to the agent.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.save.role: Primary button that uploads the crop

ui.agents.avatar.editor.saving.note: Use the locale's own ellipsis convention.
ui.agents.avatar.editor.saving.role: Same button while the upload is in flight

ui.agents.avatar.editor.zoom.role: Label of the zoom slider and its slider aria-label

ui.agents.avatar.editor.zoom_in.role: Accessible name of the zoom-in button

ui.agents.avatar.editor.zoom_out.role: Accessible name of the zoom-out button

ui.agents.avatar.editor.zoom_value.note: A number already formatted with two decimals, followed by a multiplication sign. Keep U+00D7.
